text: Are you having her finger stick to see how much of a difference it is? Doctor should not be going by the sensor numbers but her blood test.

author: Barrie Linch
text: Linda Goins Fox Doctors are increasingly using the sensors to make decisions. The problem with a single blood test (as we all know) is that it's just a moment in time and the downside of an A1c is that, as an average, it doesn't indicate the highs and lows. Time in range is viewed as a more reliable indication of glucose control than just A1c and time in range is only available using the sensor.
